formulas.description: Combining both HubSpot Original Source Drill Down 1 and 2
formulas.name: DrillDown1and2
Lead1ConversionMechanism
formulas.expression: IF( OR( {!$Record.Inbound_Call__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Inbound_Chat__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Inbound_Email__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.In_Person__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Consultation__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Event__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Interactive_Tool__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Other__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Partnership__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Resource__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Trial__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Webinar__c} = TRUE ), 1,0)

formulas.name: Lead2ConversionMechanism
formulas.expression: IF( OR( {!$Record.Web_Form_Partnership__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Contact_Us__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Demo__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Meeting_Scheduler__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Pricing__c} = TRUE, {!$Record.Web_Form_Purchase__c} = TRUE ), 1,0)

formulas.description: Used to simply group non inbound lead sources.
formulas.name: NonInboundForm
formulas.expression: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource},"SDR Prospecting"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource}, "AE Prospecting"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource}, "3rd Party Prospecting"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource}, "Social Prospecting"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource}, "Event"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource}, "Client/Customer Referral"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource}, "Employee Referral"), ISPICKVAL({!$Record.LeadSource}, "Partner Referral")), TRUE, FALSE)
